python3 -c "
p='/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/select_mem_test.rs'

old='''    assert_eq!(
        notices, 2,
        \"one per memory stream handed to select, got stderr={}\",
        out.stderr
    );'''
new='''    // Three, not two: php walks the arrays TWICE — once to build the descriptor sets and once to
    // translate the result back — and names the stream on both passes, so the mixed call warns
    // twice while the memory-only one warns once, its ValueError landing before the second pass.
    assert_eq!(
        notices, 3,
        \"one per pass that reached the memory stream, got stderr={}\",
        out.stderr
    );'''
assert old in s
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new,1))
print('count corrected')
